entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return. Order number is VF-8675309.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... I see an order for the VeloFit Pro-Carbon cycling shoes. Is that correct?
That's the one. I need to send them back.
I can certainly look into that. So I can document this correctly for our product team, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the fit?
They just don't fit right. I went for one ride and they gave me terrible blisters on my heel. I think the position for the cleats also feels off. It's not working for me, I just want a refund.

I'm very sorry to hear that the shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we aim for. Let me just confirm the return eligibility here. I can see you received them 16 days ago, which is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing that return for you now. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. I also see you're a VIP member with us, so for the trouble, I've added a 20% off voucher to your account for your next purchase.
Okay. Pre-paid label and a discount. Good. That's efficient. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
